mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.25%, market expectations for future rate cuts shift, lowering discount rates and lifting equity present-value valuations, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or signals hold during a restrictive policy stance
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in qualifying periods are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the same period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 2% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market strengthening not preceded by major inflationary shocks
failure_condition: In qualifying triggers, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat, and the IC (from a linear regression) exceeds 0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in retail sales (HOUST) of at least 3% for three consecutive months, without a corresponding spike in inflation (CPIAUCSL), predicts stronger near-term consumer spending and corporate revenue, generating a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥3% for three consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL increases by <0.5% over the same period
regime_hint: Moderate demand expansion in a low-inflation environment
failure_condition: Five-day forward returns are negative or zero, and the IC (from a regression of returns on HOUST lag and CPIAUCSL) is < -0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 2% while the S&P 500 20-day forward return in the prior month was positive signals a dislocation between economic output and market optimism, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >2% in a month with prior SPX 20d return > 0
regime_hint: Discrepancy between weak output and strong market sentiment
failure_condition: In such triggers, the 20-day forward return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.10) in a two-sample test.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the 12-month moving average of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 3.0% for two consecutive months, while the federal funds rate remains unchanged, suggests deflationary pressure that lowers real discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL 12mo_avg < 3.0 for two consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS unchanged for the same months
regime_hint: Deflationary trend in a steady policy environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat in all months satisfying the trigger, and the IC (from CPIAUCSL lag and FEDFUNDS) is < -0.15.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden, one-time increase in job openings (RSAFS) exceeding 500,000 in a month accompanied by a rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) of at least 100,000, signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 500000 in a single month AND PAYEMS increases by ≥100000 in the same month
regime_hint: Sudden labor market loosening not preceded by large inflation spikes
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in all qualifying months, and the IC (from RSAFS lag and PAYEMS) is < -0.2.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in consumer confidence (not directly observable in the provided proxies) is proxy-ed by a downward trend in retail sales (HOUST) and a simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) of at least 0.3 percentage points, both over three consecutive months, predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines by ≥1% for three consecutive months AND UNRATE rises by ≥0.3pp over the same three months
regime_hint: Persistent weakening in consumer sentiment indicators
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's 20-day return (p > 0.10) in all qualifying months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls by more than 3% in a month while the S&P 500 20-day forward return in the prior month was also negative, it signals a deepening supply-side shock that depresses corporate earnings expectations, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >3% in a month with prior SPX 20d return < 0
regime_hint: Persistent supply disruptions amid market pessimism
failure_condition: Five-day forward returns are not statistically more negative than zero (p > 0.10) in months satisfying the trigger.
